cmd:paint.contentAwareMove.params: {"offset":[dx,dy] (how far the selection was dragged),"mode":"move|extend"="move","structure":1..7=4 (7 keeps the content up to its edge, lower blends a wider edge band),"color":0..10=0 (how far the content's colour adapts to its new place),"sampleAllLayers":bool=false,"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target} → {"damage","offset","mode"} (a background job; the selection moves with the content)
cmd:paint.contentAwareMove.desc: Move or extend the selection's content, letting the engine blend it into its new place.

cmd:paint.patch.label: Patch
cmd:paint.patch.params: {"offset":[dx,dy] (how far the selection was dragged),"mode":"source|destination"="source","layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target} → {"damage","offset"}
cmd:paint.patch.desc: Repair an area by patching it with pixels from where the selection is dragged.

cmd:paint.symmetryDisable.label: Disable Symmetry Path
cmd:paint.symmetryDisable.desc: Turn symmetry off so brush, pencil and eraser strokes paint without mirroring.

cmd:paint.symmetryFromPath.label: Make Symmetry Path
cmd:paint.symmetryFromPath.params: {"name":"work"|"layer"|savedPathName="work"} — mirror Brush, Pencil and Eraser strokes across the path
cmd:paint.symmetryFromPath.desc: Mirror brush, pencil and eraser strokes across a path for symmetrical painting.

cmd:path.bendSegment.label: Drag Segment
cmd:path.bendSegment.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j (the segment leaving it),"t":0..1=0.5 (where it was grabbed),"move":[dx,dy] (a straight segment moves with its anchors; a curve reshapes through the dragged point)} → {name,path}
cmd:path.bendSegment.desc: Drag a path segment to bend its curve or shift a straight segment with its anchors.

cmd:path.clippingPath.clear.label: Clear Clipping Path
cmd:path.clippingPath.clear.desc: Remove the clipping path set for exporting the document.

cmd:path.clippingPath.set.label: Clipping Path
cmd:path.clippingPath.set.desc: Set a saved path as the clipping path used when the PSD is exported.

cmd:path.convertPoint.label: Convert Point
cmd:path.convertPoint.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j,"out":[x,y]? (none: corner with retracted handles; given: smooth with this out handle and its mirror)} → {name,path}
cmd:path.convertPoint.desc: Convert a path point between a sharp corner and a smooth point with handles.

cmd:path.moveAnchors.label: Drag Anchor Points
cmd:path.moveAnchors.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"anchors":[[subpath,knot],…],"move":[dx,dy] (anchors move with their handles; Direct Selection drag)} → {name,path}
cmd:path.moveAnchors.desc: Move chosen path anchor points, their handles following, like a direct selection drag.

cmd:path.moveHandle.label: Drag Direction Point
cmd:path.moveHandle.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j,"handle":"in|out","to":[x,y],"independent":bool=false (a smooth point turns its other handle to stay collinear; independent = ⌥ / Convert Point, makes a corner)} → {name,path}
cmd:path.moveHandle.desc: Drag a path point's direction handle to reshape its curve, independently if wanted.

cmd:path.style.copyFill.label: Copy Fill
cmd:path.style.copyFill.desc: Copy the active shape layer's fill for pasting elsewhere.

cmd:path.style.copyStroke.label: Copy Complete Stroke
cmd:path.style.copyStroke.desc: Copy the active shape layer's complete stroke for pasting elsewhere.

cmd:path.style.pasteFill.label: Paste Fill
cmd:path.style.pasteFill.params: {"layer":id?} (pastes copied fill onto active shape layer)
cmd:path.style.pasteFill.desc: Paste a previously copied fill onto the active shape layer.

cmd:path.style.pasteStroke.label: Paste Complete Stroke
cmd:path.style.pasteStroke.params: {"layer":id?} (pastes copied stroke onto active shape layer)
cmd:path.style.pasteStroke.desc: Paste a previously copied stroke onto the active shape layer.

cmd:path.transform.label: Free Transform Path
cmd:path.transform.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with layer target),"matrix":[a,b,c,d,e,f] | "translateX":px?,"translateY":px?,"scaleX":factor?,"scaleY":factor?,"angle":degrees?} (numeric transforms pivot on path bounds center)
cmd:path.transform.desc: Scale, rotate or translate a path numerically around the center of its bounds.

cmd:select.drop.label: Drop Floating Selection
cmd:select.drop.params: {} → {dropped, offset} (drops the floating piece into its layer and moves the selection with it: one history step)
cmd:select.drop.desc: Drop the floating selection into its layer, moving the selection outline with it.

cmd:select.float.label: Float Selection
cmd:select.float.params: {"dx":px=0,"dy":px=0} → {layer, offset} (cuts the selected pixels of the active layer into a floating piece the first time, then moves it by whole pixels; dropped by select.drop or any other command, put back by edit.undo)
cmd:select.float.desc: Cut the selected pixels into a floating piece that moves in whole pixels until dropped.

cmd:select.magneticLasso.label: Magnetic Lasso
cmd:select.magneticLasso.params: {"points":[[x,y],…] (≥3 fastening points in order; with trace=false, the finished outline),"width":1..256=10 (px: follows edges this close to the points),"contrast":1..100=10 (%: weaker edges are ignored),"close":"magnetic|straight"="magnetic" (how the last point joins the first),"trace":bool=true,"mode":"replace|add|subtract|intersect"="replace","antiAlias":bool=true,"feather":0..1000=0 (px)}
cmd:select.magneticLasso.desc: Trace a selection that snaps to edges between the points you fasten.

cmd:tools.decreaseBrushHardness.label: Decrease Brush Hardness
cmd:tools.decreaseBrushHardness.desc: Make the current brush edge softer by decreasing its hardness.

cmd:tools.increaseBrushHardness.label: Increase Brush Hardness
cmd:tools.increaseBrushHardness.desc: Make the current brush edge harder by increasing its hardness.

cmd:type.caret.label: Type Caret
cmd:type.caret.params: {"layer":id?, "index":char (0..=length; empty text is 0)} → {"index","line","segment":[[x,y],[x,y]]} caret segment in document pixels, for rotated and vertical type too
cmd:type.caret.desc: Report the caret's character index and pixel segment for a text layer position.

cmd:type.hitTest.label: Hit-Test Type
cmd:type.hitTest.params: {"layer":id?, "x":px, "y":px} → {"layer","index":char,"line","inside":bool}. No layer: the topmost visible type layer whose laid-out text or rendered pixels contain the point (same order as the Type tool); a miss is an error. With a layer, index is the nearest caret even when inside is false
cmd:type.hitTest.desc: Find which text layer and character a document point falls on.

cmd:type.navigate.label: Navigate Type
cmd:type.navigate.params: {"layer":id?, "index":char, "move":"wordPrev|wordNext|linePrev|lineNext|lineStart|lineEnd|start|end", "x":px?} → {"index"}. Words are alphanumeric runs. x is the document x to keep across linePrev/lineNext (a caret segment's x); omitted uses the caret's own column. Empty text returns index 0
cmd:type.navigate.desc: Move a text caret by words or lines, or to the start or end.

cmd:view.layerMask.label: View Layer Mask
cmd:view.layerMask.params: {"layer":id?,"mode":"off"|"gray"|"overlay"|"toggleGray"|"toggleOverlay"="toggleGray"} (gray: the mask alone, ⌥-click its thumbnail; overlay: red rubylith over the composite, ⇧⌥-click; view state, not an undo step; painting while shown paints the mask)
cmd:view.layerMask.desc: Show a layer's mask alone in gray or as a red overlay while editing.

tool:jobs_cancel.text0: Cancel a background job by id (or every running job when `job` is omitted). The document is left unchanged.
tool:jobs_cancel.desc: Cancel a background job by id (or every running job when `job` is omitted). The document is left unchanged.

tool:jobs_list.text0: List background jobs: running ones with progress (0-1), message and elapsed time, then the last few that ended (state done|failed|cancelled with their result or error). Finished jobs are applied first.
tool:jobs_list.desc: List background jobs: running ones with progress (0-1), message and elapsed time, then the last few that ended (state done|failed|cancelled with their result or error). Finished jobs are applied first.
